# NIIBS GPA Calculator

> Official academic evaluation, SGPA calculation, and cumulative CGPA forecasting tool for undergraduates at the Nāgānanda International Institute for Buddhist Studies (NIIBS).

## Main Application Views

- [NIIBS GPA Calculator Home](https://niibsgpa.buddhirangana.com/): Primary web application interface for calculating SGPA and CGPA.
- [Faculty Syllabus Calculator](https://niibsgpa.buddhirangana.com/): Pre-configured course credit grids for FCIT, FBS, and FHSS faculties.
- [CGPA Tracker & Semester Log](https://niibsgpa.buddhirangana.com/): Multi-semester cumulative GPA logging, transcript view, PDF export, and CSV export.
- [Target CGPA Planner](https://niibsgpa.buddhirangana.com/): Target planning tool to calculate required average GPA for remaining credit hours.

## Supported Academic Faculties

- [Faculty of Computing & Information Technology (FCIT)](https://niibsgpa.buddhirangana.com/): 4.0 GPA scale standard, BSc (Hons.) in Information Technology curriculum.
- [Faculty of Buddhist Studies (FBS)](https://niibsgpa.buddhirangana.com/): 4.0 GPA scale standard, BA & BA (Hons.) in Buddhist Studies curriculum.
- [Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences (FHSS)](https://niibsgpa.buddhirangana.com/): 4.0 GPA scale standard, BA & BA (Hons.) degree programs.
